def rands(amount: Decimal) -> str:
    """``Decimal('12070')`` -> ``R 12 070.00``."""
    q = amount.quantize(Decimal("0.01"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
    whole, cents = f"{q:.2f}".split(".")
    groups = []
    while len(whole) > 3:
        groups.insert(0, whole[-3:])
        whole = whole[:-3]
    groups.insert(0, whole)
    return f"R {' '.join(groups)}.{cents}"

    Returns the total of every portion that states a ``size_m2``; ``None`` when

    the extraction model is asked to add up (hard rule 3, no invented facts).

    sizes = [p.size_m2 for p in physical.portions if p.size_m2 is not None]

class _CallbackHandler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    """Catch the single OAuth redirect and stash the query params."""
    result: dict = {}
    def do_GET(self) -> None:  # noqa: N802 - stdlib naming
        parsed = urllib.parse.urlparse(self.path)
        _CallbackHandler.result = dict(urllib.parse.parse_qsl(parsed.query))
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
        self.end_headers()
        ok = "code" in _CallbackHandler.result

def safe_log(value: object, limit: int = 120) -> str:
    """Neutralise an attacker-controlled string for a single log line.
    Strips CR/LF (so a submitted email or header cannot forge extra log records)
    and caps the length. Used on the email/IP that reach the failed-login logs.
    """
    s = str(value if value is not None else "")
    s = s.replace("\r", " ").replace("\n", " ").replace("\t", " ")
    return s[:limit]
